rawToolName: AI APIs and Developer Tools via Harvard API Platform
description: AI APIs and Developer Tools via Harvard API Platform is available through Harvard's API Platform for eligible users. The platform offers self-service AI API access, including pay-as-you-go or limited-access credit-redemption options; some individual APIs have limited eligibility stated in their documentation. API/developer services are approved up to Level 3 confidential data. Account access is separate from course, research-use and feature-specific approval.
howToObtain: Use the Harvard API Platform if eligible; check the documentation for the specific API.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Self-service AI API access for eligible users is available through Harvard’s API Platform . These include pay-as-you-go or limited-access, credit-redemption options, including the FAS OpenAI “Community Developer” API (HarvardKey-protected). For additional guidance on these and other AI offerings, request a consultation .
* Programmatic access to Generative AI APIs for services from providers including AWS Bedrock (for Anthropic, Meta, and other model families), OpenAI Direct, and Google Gemini.
Some self-service AI APIs in the portal have limited availability. Where this is the case, it's noted in the documentation for the API
Approved for up to Level 3 confidential data

description: Harvard Claude is available in paid Standard and Premium tiers, with requests reviewed and approved by Schools and Units. Licences include Chat, Code, Cowork and Science; API keys use a separate API Platform path. Chat and Code are approved up to Level 3 confidential data; Cowork requires active monitoring of autonomous sessions. Connectors require security/privacy approval. Tool access does not grant assessment permission.
howToObtain: Request through the appropriate School/Unit form; requests require approval.
costToUser: Standard and Premium tiers have different monthly costs.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: There are two tiers of Harvard Claude licenses, each with a different monthly cost :
More details on each tier are listed in the request forms linked below. Requests are reviewed and approved by Schools and Units.
* Claude Chat and Code are approved for work using up to Level 3 confidential data .
* Claude Cowork is approved for tasks involving up to Level 3 confidential data providing you actively monitor autonomous sessions.
All connectors must be reviewed and approved for security and privacy compliance before being enabled.

description: Harvard-managed ChatGPT Edu is available by request at a monthly cost, with School or Unit approval and the service's listed eligibility. Codex is included with Harvard ChatGPT Edu licences. ChatGPT Chat and Codex are approved up to Level 3 confidential data; ChatGPT Work requires active monitoring of autonomous sessions for that data level. API keys require separate API Platform access, and connectors require security/privacy approval. Institutional access does not grant assessment permission.
howToObtain: Request a ChatGPT Edu licence through the appropriate School/Unit form; local approval and listed eligibility required.
costToUser: Monthly licence cost; Codex included, API access separate.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: ChatGPT Edu is available by request at a monthly cost . Requests are reviewed and approved by Schools and Units.
* Codex: An AI coding agent for software-development tasks, including understanding codebases, writing and reviewing code, debugging, and working through complex development workflows.
Faculty, staff, and researchers in Central Administration, FAS, College, DCE, GSAS, SEAS, GSD, GSE, HKS, HDS, HLS, HMS (Quad), Radcliffe, SPH; Students in College, GSAS, SEAS, GSE, HKS, SPH
Local approval required.
* ChatGPT Chat and Codex are approved for work using up to Level 3 confidential data .
* ChatGPT Work is approved for tasks involving up to Level 3 confidential data providing you actively monitor autonomous sessions.
All connectors must be reviewed and approved for security and privacy compliance before being enabled.

description: Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM; Basic) is included in Harvard's Basic Google Workspace tier for eligible account holders. Gemini Notebook is the current name of NotebookLM; Pro includes expanded Notebook limits. HUIT lists specific eligible Schools and user groups, with local approval for some Google Workspace account requests. Standard Gemini products are approved up to Level 3 confidential data, while agent sessions require active monitoring and connectors require separate review. Access is separate from assessment permission.
howToObtain: Use an eligible Harvard Google Workspace account; local account approval may be required. Request Google AI Pro for Education for the paid tier.
costToUser: Basic tier: free for eligible users.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Basic tier (available to all Harvard Google Workspace users):

* Source-grounded research (Gemini Notebook, formerly NotebookLM): Create up to 200 notebooks, each with up to 200 sources (up to 500K words/200MB per source), with up to 200 daily chat prompts to generate summaries, audio/video overviews, quizzes, flashcards, and reports grounded strictly in your source documents.
Premium tier: Google AI Pro for Education (by request at additional cost):
Faculty, staff, and researchers in FAS, College, DCE, SEAS; Students in FAS, College, DCE*, GSAS, SEAS, HBS, HLS
Central Administration, GSE, HBS, HDS, HKS, and HMS (Quad), and HSPH require local approval for Google Workspace account requests.
* Standard Products are approved for work using up to Level 3 confidential data .
* Agent is approved for tasks involving up to Level 3 confidential data providing you actively monitor autonomous sessions.

description: Harvard Microsoft Copilot Chat is included at no extra cost for eligible Harvard Microsoft 365 users, who sign in with HarvardKey. The Premium tier is available by request at additional cost and includes Microsoft 365 application integration. The service lists School/user eligibility. Institutional access and Level 3 approval for named managed products do not grant assessment permission; meeting use and connector approvals have additional conditions.
howToObtain: Sign in with HarvardKey for Basic; request an approved Premium licence for the additional tier.
costToUser: Basic: no extra cost with eligible Harvard Microsoft 365 account.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: * Copilot Chat: An AI chat assistant available in Microsoft Teams, Outlook, the Microsoft 365 app, and the Edge sidebar. Included with your Harvard Microsoft 365 account at no extra cost, with web-grounded answers, writing help, and general productivity assistance.
Premium tier (available by request at additional cost):
Faculty, staff, researchers, and students in Central Administration, FAS, College, DCE*, GSAS, SEAS, GSD, GSE, HKS, HLS, HMS (Quad), HSDM (Quad), Radcliffe, SPH
* All Harvard Microsoft 365 users have access to the basic tier of Copilot. Sign in with your HarvardKey at copilot.cloud.microsoft .
* Copilot Chat and Copilot in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams are approved for work using up to Level 3 confidential data .
